title: Parent-KL candidate generic-greedy fresh5k Slumbot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The parent-KL candidate's significant internal gain and strict outcome-free preservation can transfer at least non-negatively under the same generic greedy execution contract as its externally strongest parent.
material_change: Freeze candidate SHA 1c050edb... and run exactly eight new 625-hand greedy Slumbot sessions, seeds 2026110301..08, with fresh runtime, full raw replay audit, token disjointness, and independent raw/session CIs.
baseline: Parent greedy fresh5k -9.4188 (3/8 positive); failed weak-KL tail -91.0228 (1/8 positive)
notes: No retry, replacement, score stopping, pooling, or automatic extension.

result.summary: The parent-KL candidate completed eight new generic-greedy 625-hand sessions with full audit and independent raw recomputation, but both confidence intervals were below zero.
result.conclusion: Tight parent preservation improved neither transfer nor session breadth enough: -65.504 bb/100, raw CI upper -3.84, session CI upper -6.69, and 1/8 positive sessions. No fresh20k extension.
result.next_step: Stop this parent-KL branch. The evidence now rejects both weak and strong KL continuation as a route to external edge; next work should change the opponent/evaluation distribution or learning objective rather than tune KL or add more hands.
